extensionName: Universal Object, Hitbox & MakeCode Style Sprite Engine

newBlocks.tooltip: Carves out a structured byte-array block in safe RAM to track an entity's custom tracking states.
Instantiates a new active sprite structure in memory and flags its gameplay classification kind (e.g. Player, Enemy, Food).
Forces an instant rewrite of an entity's coordinate registers to lock it to specific spatial map positions.
Injects a continuous movement vector delta that automatically increments spatial coordinates on every clock interrupt pass.
Wipes an active sprite structure out of system registers and spawns a specific visual particle debris trail pattern.
Directly maps physical direction button inputs to an entity's coordinate registers at a set maximum speed step rate.
Locks the viewport scrolling offset camera line variables to stay centered perfectly on an entity's center point.
Performs continuous proximity bounding-box intersection sweeps between two different sprite kind indices to branch execution logic lanes.
Enforces a lifecycle flag that automatically garbage-collects a projectile or entity memory slot the frame it leaves the screen bounds.
Configures a 4-byte fine-grained environmental boundary offset matrix bypassing standard 16x16 grid constraints.
Injects a moving lighting cone, torch, or lighthouse beam using zero-math 1-bit hardware lookup tables.
Loops through all structured RAM object blocks and blits their sprite data matrices onto the screen VRAM buffer.
Calculates the precise VRAM rendering jump offset for sprite textures mapping sequences.
Increments animation loop trackers automatically based on set frame hardware delay parameters.
Reverses the horizontal rendering orientation of a texture map vector inside double buffers layout frames.
Reverses the vertical drawing layout sequence pass to flip asset textures upside down.
Executes a pixel-doubling blit matrix pass to scale rendering sizes cleanly on screen.
Designates an exact hardware color palette lookup index value as a clear skip parameter for un-boxed boundaries drawing.
